subject: Gridline customer video — slate, release, and shoot plan
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@gridlinehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Gridline Comms <comms@gridlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer video — interest + proposed dates

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the exec team is excited about highlighting our performance win with Redwood. We'd like to do a short on-camera testimonial (4–6 minutes of on-camera remarks, plus b-roll and product screenshots) to use on the website and in sales collateral.

Proposed shoot dates: June 10 or June 11. We have a small conference room with a neutral backdrop and can provide one onsite contact (me).

Can you share a sample release we can run by legal and a proposed shot list / talking points so we can prep? Also curious about crew size, estimated on-site time, and any AV needs.

I've attached our internal B-roll guidelines so you can see what shots we typically keep.

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Marketing, Gridline Health
Gridline Health
Attachment: Gridline_B-Roll_Guidelines.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@gridlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer video — interest + proposed dates

Hi Lena — great to hear. June 10 or 11 both work for us. High-level plan:

- 2-person crew (producer + DP), 1-hour setup, 2–3 hours capture per interview subject.
- Deliverables: 1 trimmed testimonial (90–180s), 1 short social cut (30s), b-roll package.
- On-camera focus areas: implementation speed, latency improvements, and unit-cost savings.

I'm attaching our standard talent/release waiver for your legal team to review. If Gridline prefers, we can send a DocuSign version — let me know.

Would you be able to confirm: preferred date, primary interviewee, and any required internal legal language? If June 11 is chosen we'll plan for a 9:00–13:00 window to allow extra b-roll.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Talent_Waiver_v1.docx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Customer video — slate, release, and shoot plan

Folks — forwarding Gridline's note. High-level asks: sample release to legal, shot list/talking points, production logistics for June 10/11.

Marissa: can you draft the on-camera script skeleton and the short list of 5 talking prompts (we want to steer to measurable outcomes)?
Stephanie: can you confirm crew availability (producer + DP + sound) and a two-hour kit list? We'll need lighting, a lav, and one B-roll camera. Proposed schedule below:

Day-of plan (proposal):
- 08:30 — crew arrives, set-up
- 09:15 — tech check / slate / pre-interview
- 09:30 — interview 1 (30–40 min)
- 10:30 — b-roll run (30–45 min)
- 11:30 — interview 2 or additional cutaways
- 12:30 — wrap

Also - plan for a short slate/consent on camera (on the record: name, title, permission to use footage in marketing). I'll coordinate the signed release but want the on-camera line too.

Thanks — P

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@gridlinehealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:29:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: script + talking points for Gridline testimonial (please review)

Hi Lena — thanks for coordinating. Draft script and talking points below (attached as a separate doc and in the Drive folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gx-example-GridlineShoot

Short format (90–120s final):
- Opening (10s): "I'm [Name], [Title] at Gridline Health."
- Problem context (15s): "We were struggling with X — long inference times and high per-prediction cost."
- Solution + outcome (40–60s): "After migrating inference to Redwood, we saw Y% latency reduction and Z% cost savings; this let us scale feature X to more users."
- Call to action / close (10s): "Redwood helped us ship this feature faster and reliably."

Suggested talking prompts for interviewer (pick 3):
- Walk me through the legacy pain points you had before the migration.
- Can you quantify the latency/cost improvements? Any example metrics?
- How did Redwood change your release velocity or product decisions?
- Any surprising benefits after switching (ops, reliability, predictability)?
- Advice for teams evaluating inference providers?

B-roll checklist: UI screens, team at work, rack/cabinet (if allowed), on-screen product latency dashboard, whiteboard post-migration notes.

Legal: attached is a copy of the standard release (we can send via DocuSign). Please have legal confirm any edits by June 3 so we can route for signature.

Tentative shoot slot: June 11, 09:00–12:00 (flexible). Please confirm the primary interviewee(s).

Attachments: Gridline_Talking_Pts_v1.md
DocuSign release: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ABC-Gridline-Release-123

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Producer, Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@gridlinehealth.com>

Please proceed with crew booking; we expect on-site contact to be me.

Best,
Lena
